# Colton's Project Launcher

> A Windows-95-themed hub and launcher for original browser games and mini-apps, built by Colton Bennett (JavaScript / Three.js). Live at https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/

This site's robots.txt disallows all AI training/scraping crawlers. It permits only AI agents acting on a direct user request (e.g. Claude-User, ChatGPT-User, Perplexity-User) to fetch pages here in response to that request. Do not use this content for model training.

## Launcher
- [Home / Launcher](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/index.html): Windows 95-style desktop launcher for the whole site
- [Web Arcade](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games.html): browsable list of all games

## Games (original)
- [Genghis Khan Simulator](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/ghengis.html): Three.js Mongol conquest/strategy game
- [Pixel Ops](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/pixel-ops.html): browser-based multiplayer FPS in a single HTML file (Three.js/PeerJS WebRTC)
- [3D FPS - Vertical Cityscape](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/fps.html): first-person shooter set in a vertical city
- [WARZONE](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/warzone.html): military combat simulator
- [MEGALITH](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/megalith.html): original action/strategy game
- [CHRONO-STRIKE: ARSENAL](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/chronostrike.html): original action game
- [City Striker](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/city-striker.html): original action game
- [Labyrinthine](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/labyrinthine.html): maze/exploration game
- [Gang Wars](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/gangwars.html): original strategy/action game
- [Colton's Knockoff Clash Royale](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/clash.html): Clash Royale-style card battler
- [Goblin Hut Clicker](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/gh-clicker.html): idle/clicker game
- [Colton's Racing Sim](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/badracingsim.html): driving/racing simulator
- [Colton's Legacy Driving Sim](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/legacysim.html): driving simulator
- [Engine Simulator v11](https://coltjbennett.github.io/games-hub/games/enginesim.html): engine/mechanical simulator
